sloka: निशाचरेन्द्रस्य निशम्य वाक्यम् ।स कुम्भकर्णस्य च गर्जितानि ।विभीषणो राक्षसराजमुख्य ।मुवाच वाक्यम् हितम्र्थयुक्तम् ॥६-१४-१॥।।
transliteration: niśācarendrasya niśamya vākyam ।sa kumbhakarṇasya ca garjitāni ।vibhīṣaṇo rākṣasarājamukhya ।muvāca vākyam hitamrthayuktam ॥6-14-1॥।।

translations.english: On hearing the statement of the Lord of Rakshasas and roaring of Kumbhakarna, looking at Ravana the king of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana said these good words appropriate of a noble person.
